milestones.title: MVP Boilerplate
milestones.description: Fixed reusable micro-SaaS baseline: application shell, auth, persistence, billing, email, observability, tests and documentation.

tasks.title: Application foundation
scope: TypeScript and pnpm project quality commands
acceptance_criteria: Application installs and builds with pnpm
lint, typecheck and tests are runnable
required environment variables are validated without committing secrets

milestones.title: Product Value Slice
milestones.description: Turn the reusable foundation into a coherent product slice derived from the repository product objective and expose one end-to-end user value path.

tasks.title: Create product objective and primary-user contract
scope: Document product problem, target user and promised outcome
acceptance_criteria: A repository-local product objective document exists
target user, problem and outcome are explicit
one primary activation event is documented and testable
done: primary journey is bounded enough to implement in one milestone

tasks.title: Implement the primary end-to-end user journey
scope: Implement the smallest complete workflow that delivers the documented product outcome
handle empty, loading and error states
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated user can complete the primary workflow end to end
created data is persisted under the existing authorization model
failure and empty states are explicit

tasks.title: Add activation-focused onboarding and dashboard entry
scope: dashboard entry into the primary workflow
acceptance_criteria: new users are guided to the primary action
returning users can resume from the dashboard
activation state is derived from product data rather than a hard-coded flag
done: onboarding and dashboard paths are covered

milestones.title: Launch Readiness
milestones.description: Make the product safe to provision and release while keeping credentials and production deployment under explicit human authority.

tasks.title: Document runtime credential and environment contract
scope: document provider ownership and required scopes
acceptance_criteria: all required credential names are documented without values
missing required configuration fails safely
no workflow creates, reads back or exports secrets
done: secret values are absent from repository history introduced by this task

tasks.title: Harden release safety, health and failure handling
acceptance_criteria: health behavior distinguishes healthy from misconfigured runtime
critical webhook handling is idempotent
production release remains HUMAN_REQUIRED

tasks.title: Produce human-gated production release checklist
acceptance_criteria: checklist clearly marks human-owned credential and production actions
no production deployment is performed by the task
post-release checks are executable and bounded

milestones.title: Market Instrumentation
milestones.description: Instrument the product so future portfolio decisions can be based on activation, conversion, retention and feedback rather than repository activity.

tasks.title: Instrument the product funnel with privacy-aware events
acceptance_criteria: events have stable documented names
no secrets or sensitive payloads are sent to analytics
events cover signup, activation and paid conversion boundaries
done: analytics instrumentation has tests where practical

tasks.title: Add an in-product user feedback loop
acceptance_criteria: authenticated users can submit feedback
feedback failures do not break the primary product flow
personally sensitive data is not required

tasks.title: Define measurable product experiment contract
acceptance_criteria: activation, conversion and retention metrics have definitions
experiments require a hypothesis and bounded evaluation window
kill criteria are documented
done: experiment contract is repository-local and machine-readable enough for future portfolio automation
